newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - lists hit ahead of deals.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - lists hit ahead of deals.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices sagged about 3/8 point in early action as several bid-wanted lists began to circulate ahead of the day's new deals.
Traders said at least seven lists are circulating now, putting pressure on secondary prices in conjunction with a sinking Treasury market.
The government long bond was down 13/32 at 96-3/32 to yield 6.81 percent.
Muni cash was down almost as much, traders said. "It's maybe not 1/2 (lower) yet, but it will be the way it looks," one trader said.
In new issue action, the Robinson-Humphrey Co said it tentatively priced $115 million Richmond County Board of Education, Ga., at a top yield of 5.95 percent in 2026. To see
Several other sizeable deals are expected to sell Tuesday. PaineWebber Inc said it plans to price $345.7 million Houston refunding bonds, in a deal expected to be the largest of the week.
BancOne said it set Tuesday for a $120 million Ohio general obligation issue.
On the competitive side, Washington tops the calendar with a $246 million two-part deal at 1130 EST.

In the muni secondary, bids were unchanged on Alliance Airport Authority, Texas, 6-3/8s of 2021, holding steady at 99-3/4. North Carolina Eastern Municipal Power Agency MBIA 5-5/8s of 2024 were 1/8 lower at 97-5/8.

Debt futures were sharply lower, with the March municipal contract down 17/32 at 114-20/32 and the March T-bond contract 14/32 lower at 110-27/32. The MOB spread was 121 ticks, narrowing from 124 at the close Monday.
